Summary: the namespace fix is sound and the three prior defects are genuinely closed with real offline coverage (12 tests, including tmpfs ENOSPC, sparse/hardlink rejection, copy-growth, orphan, and grouped cleanup faults). I'm withholding approval on two narrow, cheap items: the unverified bind target at `run-build-bounded.py:206-209` (one-in-one attempt, silent artifact loss), and the raw probe declaring a launcher hash that isn't the launcher under review. I accept the C2 outer-manifest binding alternative outright.
